non_edges.rationale: Interview success is not equivalent to job-performance validity.
Writing clarity is not itself evidence of future job performance.
Experience duration/episode presence is not equivalent to competence or performance.
Perceived person–job fit is not identical to objective/evidence-supported requirement match.
Successful parsing does not imply favorable ranking.
Keyword/semantic alignment is not equivalent to underlying competence.
A quantified outcome is not automatically strong evidence without provenance and attribution.
Visual polish is not universally proven to cause interview success.
A minimum qualification is not automatically the most important predictor of successful work.
Distinctiveness is not equivalent to diagnosticity.
Perceived credibility is not equivalent to actual evidence strength.
LLM evaluation is not equivalent to human recruiter inference.
